title: When does the cycle begin?
prompt: A Collatz orbit beginning at 6 reaches the repeating cycle 1 → 4 → 2 → 1. What is justified about that orbit?
hint: Distinguish the initial transient from a cycle reached under a known deterministic map.

options.text: It is periodic from the initial value 6.
It is eventually periodic; the transient prefix beginning at 6 need not repeat.
Any finite repeated pattern proves the entire future of any unknown process.

feedback.pass: Eventually periodic and periodic from the beginning are distinct statements.
feedback.fail: The initial value 6 is not in the cycle. A transient can precede the repeating part.
